decisions.title: Product identity and boundary
decisions.recommendation: Build a governed geospatial knowledge and action platform with four separable planes. MCP is one interface, not the product identity.
benefits: Avoids coupling product identity to a protocol
Supports humans, agents and direct APIs
Keeps providers and systems of record authoritative
disadvantages: More architecture and governance work than a server refresh
risks: Scope expansion without a firm minimum viable product
decisions.cost_complexity: High initial design; lower long-term coupling
conditions_that_change_decision: A narrowly scoped internal-only server could justify a smaller product boundary

decisions.title: Six-control governance spine
decisions.recommendation: Use the six-control spine as the primary governance view and map it to presentation, control, execution/data and evidence planes.
benefits: Keeps identity, licence, workflow and evidence end-to-end
Supports human-led and agentic processes with the same controls
risks: Teams could mistake planes for governance controls or vice versa
decisions.reversibility: High; it is a view and allocation model
conditions_that_change_decision: A mandated enterprise reference architecture may require renamed planes

decisions.title: Role of OKF
decisions.recommendation: Use OKF 0.2 as the canonical knowledge, discovery, provenance and policy-description layer. Do not make it the runtime authority, policy decision point or evidence store.
options_considered: OKF as discovery and semantic layer
disadvantages: Does not itself execute or enforce
risks: Explorer extensions could be misrepresented as normative OKF
decisions.reversibility: Medium; content remains Markdown/YAML and exportable
conditions_that_change_decision: A future normative OKF revision could change core fields or packaging

decisions.title: MCP primitive mapping
decisions.recommendation: Use resources for catalogue/schema/licence/style/evidence descriptions; tools for deterministic actions; Tasks for long jobs; Apps for optional UI; Arazzo for durable workflows.
risks: Host support differs for extensions
conditions_that_change_decision: Host interoperability tests may require compatibility shims

decisions.title: Tool surface
decisions.recommendation: Expose 12 composable, schema-rich tools instead of the 103-tool MCP-Geo catalogue. Keep provider selection behind policy-aware adapters.
benefits: Reduces model confusion and tool poisoning surface
Makes policy and evidence fields consistent
disadvantages: Generic schemas need strong selection semantics
Some provider-native capabilities need explicit extensions
risks: Over-generalisation could obscure provider constraints
decisions.reversibility: Medium; add provider profiles without changing core tools
conditions_that_change_decision: Evaluation may show a small number of provider-specific tools are safer

decisions.title: MCP protocol and SDK target
decisions.recommendation: Target MCP 2026-07-28 and the official TypeScript SDK at a pinned release/commit. Keep protocol conformance tests against official fixtures and major hosts.
benefits: Uses final stateless model and current routing/discovery
disadvantages: Some hosts may lag and need compatibility behaviour
risks: Extension support may remain uneven
decisions.reversibility: Medium; protocol adapters can support older clients temporarily
conditions_that_change_decision: A critical host lacks final-protocol support and cannot be upgraded

decisions.title: WebMCP adoption level
decisions.recommendation: Run a bounded, open-data, read-only WebMCP experiment in the static HMLR/Explorer site. Do not expose privileged operations, credentials or policy decisions through it.
benefits: Tests agent-ready website discovery without scraping
risks: API churn and origin/lifecycle attacks
conditions_that_change_decision: W3C standards-track status, stable browser support and resolved security model could justify wider adoption

decisions.title: MCP Apps approach
decisions.recommendation: Use MCP Apps for optional map, inspector, provenance and approval views. Every capability must return a complete deterministic non-UI result and use the same policy/evidence path.
disadvantages: Widget security boundary must be maintained
risks: Widget becoming an alternate ungoverned API
conditions_that_change_decision: Host support remains too limited to justify maintenance

decisions.title: Authentication and delegated authority
decisions.recommendation: Use OIDC/OAuth 2.1, authorisation code with PKCE for humans, workload identity for services, token exchange/on-behalf-of where supported, and short-lived transaction-bound permits for sensitive actions.
options_considered: Federated actor chain and transaction permits
risks: Bearer leakage or overbroad scopes if implementation shortcuts are taken
decisions.reversibility: Medium; identity provider can change behind standards
conditions_that_change_decision: Enterprise identity constraints mandate a different federation pattern

decisions.title: ABAC and policy engine
decisions.recommendation: Use Open Policy Agent/Rego as the principal portable PDP, with policy information from trusted identity, entitlement, licence, provider and risk services. Keep relationship data available as input rather than adopting a separate ReBAC engine initially.
disadvantages: Rego skills and policy lifecycle needed
Relationship graph queries need an external PIP
risks: Policy complexity and stale attribute inputs
decisions.reversibility: Medium; authority context and decisions remain engine-neutral
conditions_that_change_decision: AWS becomes the mandated platform with Verified Permissions already operated
Relationship-heavy entitlements dominate

decisions.title: Trusted device posture
decisions.recommendation: Use Entra Conditional Access and Intune-compliance claims as trusted posture evidence for the first protected pilot. Never accept posture asserted directly by the MCP client.
benefits: Policy can downgrade or deny on posture change
risks: Stale posture or claims forwarded without validation
decisions.reversibility: Medium; posture PIP interface is provider-neutral
conditions_that_change_decision: Pilot identity estate is not Entra/Intune

decisions.title: Access and cache isolation
decisions.recommendation: Operate open, PSGA and commercial data planes as physically separate deployments/stores/caches/keys/identities. Share source code, schemas and reviewed policy definitions only.
benefits: Simpler incident and licence withdrawal boundaries
risks: Configuration drift across tiers
decisions.reversibility: Low-to-medium once protected data is loaded
conditions_that_change_decision: A formal risk assessment proves logical separation sufficient for a narrowly bounded dataset

decisions.title: Canonical geospatial storage and formats
decisions.recommendation: Use PostGIS for authoritative/queryable vector state and indexes; object storage for GeoParquet, PMTiles, COG and downloadable artefacts; DuckDB Spatial for isolated embedded analytics; GeoJSON only for bounded results.
benefits: Right storage for transactional queries and bulk delivery
risks: Stale projections between database and artefacts
conditions_that_change_decision: The MVP remains metadata-only and needs no spatial database

decisions.title: Live API versus cache strategy
decisions.recommendation: Prefer live provider APIs for volatile, transactional or legally authoritative results; use governed versioned caches for reference geographies, approved open bulk data, performance-critical tiles and outage resilience.
benefits: Balances freshness, cost, resilience and rights
risks: Stale or licence-invalid cache use
conditions_that_change_decision: Provider terms prohibit caching or provide guaranteed low-latency services

decisions.title: Open demonstrator hosting
decisions.recommendation: Publish the research pack and Stage 1 open demonstrator as a static, portable site, initially compatible with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Treat ChatGPT Sites as an optional open/synthetic mirror only after UK account availability is verified.
disadvantages: No protected operations or server-side policy
risks: Mutable hosted routes must not be mistaken for immutable evidence
conditions_that_change_decision: A mandated publishing platform provides equivalent portability and accessibility

decisions.title: Protected production hosting
decisions.recommendation: Use Azure UK for the first protected pilot: Container Apps/App Service, Azure Database for PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Blob Storage, Entra ID/Conditional Access, managed identities, Key Vault, API Management and Monitor. Keep contracts portable to GCP and AWS.
benefits: Best fit with Entra-managed public-sector users and devices
UK region and managed data services
risks: Cloud lock-in if IaC and contracts are not portable
conditions_that_change_decision: Departmental landing zone mandates GCP or AWS
Protected pilot lacks Entra integration

decisions.title: Language and runtime
decisions.recommendation: Use a TypeScript MCP/control gateway and a Python deterministic geospatial execution service. Keep it to these two deployable services initially.
risks: Distributed failure and version drift
conditions_that_change_decision: Official Python SDK closes all control-plane gaps and a single-service implementation passes the same assurance

decisions.title: Repository reset and migration
decisions.recommendation: Create a new repository for Locus Accord only after this decision phase. Archive MCP-Geo as a learning journal. Migrate selected assets through a tested harvest, never by copying the repository wholesale.
disadvantages: Migration planning and duplication during transition
risks: Valuable edge cases could be missed
conditions_that_change_decision: Organisational policy requires continuity in the existing repository

decisions.title: Minimum viable scope
decisions.recommendation: Stage 0 creates evidence, schemas and test harness; Stage 1 publishes an HMLR/ONS/LandIS open discovery pack; Stage 2 adds a small open read-only MCP service. Identity, PSGA and commercial work follow only after evidence gates.
options_considered: All providers and tiers at once
Open discovery and read-only MCP first
risks: Open demonstrator could be mistaken for production readiness
conditions_that_change_decision: A funded protected pilot supplies its identity, licence and governance prerequisites from day one

decisions.title: Working project name
decisions.recommendation: Use Locus Accord (`locus-accord`) as the working codename. It expresses place plus an explicit agreement between authority, policy, data and action. Do not claim legal clearance.
benefits: Not tied to MCP or a provider
Fits repository, package and service naming
disadvantages: Two-word Latin/English blend may need explanation
risks: Trademark, package, domain or product conflict not found in preliminary checks
conditions_that_change_decision: UKIPO/package/domain checks identify a conflict
Stakeholder research rejects the name
